summary.en-US: Shows card values and trade profitability on kyara.games, with filters and sorting for trade offers.
summary.fr: Affiche la valeur des cartes et la rentabilité des échanges sur kyara.games, avec filtres et tri des offres.

version.approval_notes: Build: Node 24 + pnpm 12. Run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` then `pnpm build`; the output is .output/firefox-mv2/. Sources are attached. The extension only runs on kyara.games. webRequestBlocking + filterResponseData read the JSON responses the site already loads (prices, collection) and always pass them through untouched; nothing is sent anywhere except kyara.games' own API, with the user's existing session token.
